items.stem: Which statement about the reaction of Group VII elements with hydrogen is correct?

options.text: Fluorine reacts explosively even in the dark.
Iodine reacts explosively even in the dark.
Chlorine has almost no reaction with hydrogen even on strong heating.
Bromine is unreactive towards hydrogen under all conditions.

items.stem:
The atomic number of element X is 35. Which of the following elements has chemical properties
similar to those of element X?
Which of the following statements about halogens is correct?

options.text: All of them have the same colour.
They have the same number of occupied electron shells in their atoms.
Their reactivity decreases down the group.
Bromine is the only liquid element at room temperature and pressure.

options.text: They are found in the air.
All of their atoms have an octet structure in the outermost shells.

items.stem:
Which of the following statements about iodine are correct?
(1) It is a black solid at room conditions.
(2) It is in Period 4 of the periodic table.
(3) It can react with metals to form salts.

Which of the following statements about Group 0 elements are correct?
(1) They are all colourless gases at room temperature and pressure.
(2) They have 8 outermost shell electrons in their atoms.
(3) Their atomic sizes increase down the group.

The atomic number of the element astatine (At) is 85. Which of the following statements about astatine
is / are correct?
(1) It is a gas at room temperature and pressure.
(2) It is soluble in non-aqueous solvents.
(3) It has a giant covalent structure.

The element astatine is below iodine in Group VII of the periodic table. Which of the following
statements about astatine is / are correct?
(1) It is a coloured solid at room conditions.
(2) It is more reactive than chlorine.
(3) It is a Period 5 element.

The element krypton (Kr) is below argon in Group 0 of the periodic table. Which of the following
statements about krypton are correct?
(1) Its atom has an octet structure in the outermost shell.
(2) It is in Period 4 of the periodic table.
(3) Its density is higher than that of argon.
Astatine is below iodine in Group VII. Which statement is most likely to be correct?

options.text: Astatine is a colourless gas at room temperature.
Astatine is more reactive than iodine.
Astatine is less reactive than iodine and is darker in colour.
